whenToUse: Codes with a fixed number of digits, such as phone or two-factor verification.
You let people fill in a code from a text message with autofill.
Showing how many digits are left would help.
whenNotToUse: Codes without a fixed length (use a text field).
Long keys that mix in letters (paste into a text field).

alternatives.name: Text Field
alternatives.reason: Taking the code in one field with inputmode=numeric.

accessibility: Group the boxes with role="group", and give each a name such as "Verification code digit 1 of 6".
Put autocomplete="one-time-code" on the first box so SMS autofill works.
inputmode="numeric" opens the number pad, and anything other than digits is ignored.
Backspace moves to the previous box, the arrows move between boxes, and the result is announced with role="status".
